nodes.description: External caller address; used as token payer/payee, coupon owner, voter and incentive recipient across Bonding, Market, Govern and the incentivized advance path.
Miner-controllable timestamp; feeds epoch derivation (epochTimeWithStrategy), coupon redemption penalty and the Advance event.
Stored oracle price (Decimal.D256) written by setPrice and read by redeemCoupons and the incentivized modifier.
Global outstanding debt; mutated by increment/decrementTotalDebt and used in couponPremium.
Global redeemable pool; adjusted by increment/decrementTotalRedeemable during redemption and supply expansion.
Mapping of Account.State per user (staged, balance, coupons, allowances, fluidUntil, lockedUntil).
Current epoch counter advanced by incrementEpoch and derived from block.timestamp.
Active oracle provider address, swapped in initialize together with the legacy uniswap oracle.
EIP-1967 implementation storage slot in the proxy; read via assembly sload and written via assembly sstore.
Mapping of Candidate.State per proposal address (start, period, approve, reject, votes, initialized).
Initializer guarded by the initializer modifier; sets new oracle/pool, calls oracle.setup() and oracle.capture(), and mints the initial 2000e18 balances to three hard-coded addresses.
External epoch advancement entry point combining Bonding.step, Regulator.step and Market.step, wrapped in the incentivized modifier.
Modifier that reads Chainlink ETH/gas feeds after execution and mints a gas reimbursement to msg.sender.
External deposit; pulls DSD from msg.sender via transferFrom and credits staged balance.
External withdraw guarded by onlyFrozenOrLocked; transfers DSD to msg.sender before decrementing the staged balance (state update after external call).
External bond guarded by onlyFrozenOrFluid; unfreezes caller and computes new shares from totalBonded/totalSupply.
External unbond guarded by onlyFrozenOrFluid; converts bonded shares back to staged amounts.
External unbond variant that withdraws the underlying staged amount and burns the corresponding bonded shares.
External coupon purchase; validates debt coverage, splits deposit+premium in half between expirable coupons and always-reclaimable underlying, then burns the caller's DSD.
External coupon redemption; requires expansion, requires epoch().sub(couponEpoch) >= 2, applies penalty burn and pays out via redeemToAccount.
External one-shot migration of a coupon epoch into coupon underlying (half of the coupon balance).
External coupon allowance setter for the caller as owner.
External coupon transfer for a given sender/epoch; decrements the spender allowance when msg.sender != sender.
Public view computing the time-decayed redemption penalty; mixes block.timestamp and raw uint256 arithmetic (Constants math is done without SafeMath).
Public view delegating to Curve.calculateCouponPremium using dollar total supply and total debt.
Internal market step: expires prior epochs' coupons and schedules expiry for the current epoch's coupons.
External governance vote guarded by onlyFrozenOrLocked; may create a candidate and re-tallies approve/reject balances.
External proposal commit; checks quorum vs totalBondedAt(endsAfter) and approval, then upgrades the proxy to the candidate.
External emergency commit using super-majority of totalSupply and the emergency delay, then upgrades the proxy.
Internal upgrade routine calling setImplementation then delegatecalling initialize() on the new implementation.
Private setter verifying the target is a contract and writing the implementation slot with inline assembly.
Internal mint of DSD to an account, increasing debt during non-bootstrap epochs and running balanceCheck.
Internal burn; pulls DSD from the account via transferFrom, burns it and decrements global debt.
Internal redemption payout minting new DSD and transferring coupon DSD, decrementing total redeemable.
Internal regulator step: captures the oracle price, stores it and expands/contracts supply.
Internal price acquisition calling oracle().capture() with bootstrapping/validity fallbacks.
Internal supply expansion: mints pool/treasury rewards, trues up the redeemable pool and mints remaining supply to the DAO.
Public view reading the proxy implementation address from storage via inline assembly sload.
External call dollar().mint(...) that creates new DSD supply from several internal paths.
External call dollar().transferFrom(...) pulling user funds into the contract during deposit and burn paths.
External call dollar().burn(...) destroying DSD held by the contract.
External call dollar().transfer(...) sending DSD to a user or the coupon redeemer; performed before state decrements in withdraw.
delegatecall into the candidate implementation with the proxy's full storage context, executed after the governance quorum check.
Inline assembly sstore that writes the implementation address into the fixed EIP-1967 storage slot.
External call oracle().capture() returning (Decimal.D256, bool) that drives supply expansion/contraction.
Two Chainlink aggregator latestRoundData() calls whose returned prices are used without staleness/validity checks to compute the advance incentive.
Raw uint256 arithmetic in couponRedemptionPenalty (subtractions of couponAge/timeIntoEpoch from constants) performed without SafeMath, unlike the rest of the protocol.
Caller-supplied DSD amount for Bonding.deposit.
Caller-supplied DSD amount used to buy coupons.
Coupon epoch selected by the caller for redemption.
Coupon underlying amount to redeem.
Slippage guard for the redemption output amount.
Candidate implementation address being voted on.
Vote enum value (UNDECIDED/APPROVE/REJECT) cast by the caller.
New implementation address passed to upgradeTo/setImplementation.
Penalty burn computed by couponRedemptionPenalty inside redeemCoupons.
Coupon amount derived from the caller's coupon/underlying ratio, later reduced by the penalty.
Expansion amount computed by the regulator and consumed by increaseSupply.
gasleft() snapshot taken before execution to size the advance incentive.
Recipient account of an internal mint (user, pool, treasury, DAO or caller).
Coupon transfer recipient supplied by the caller.

edges.reason: msg.sender is the account whose DSD is pulled into the contract by deposit().
msg.sender receives the withdrawn DSD and is the account whose staged balance is decremented.
msg.sender is unfrozen, credited shares and debited staged balance in bond().
msg.sender's shares are converted back to staged balance in unbond().
msg.sender is the pool participant whose underlying and shares are moved in unbondUnderlying().
msg.sender receives the coupons and pays the DSD deposit burned by purchaseCoupons().
msg.sender's coupon and underlying balances are consumed and the payout is sent to msg.sender.
msg.sender's coupon balance for the epoch is migrated into coupon underlying.
msg.sender is the owner granting the coupon allowance.
msg.sender is checked as spender against allowanceCoupons when not equal to sender.
msg.sender's bonded stake is read and tallied into the candidate vote totals.
msg.sender triggers commit and is recorded in the Commit event.
msg.sender (any external caller) drives the privileged epoch advance by paying gas.
The incentive computed in the modifier is minted directly to msg.sender without further authorization.
block.timestamp % epoch period and the derived coupon age determine the redemption penalty.
Epoch derivation from block.timestamp (via epochTimeWithStrategy) is miner-influenced.
block.timestamp is emitted in the Advance event and used for epoch progress checks.
purchaseCoupons writes coupons and coupon underlying into the caller's account state.
redeemCoupons decrements coupon, underlying and allowance entries of the caller.
migrateCoupons zeroes or reduces the caller's coupon entry and credits underlying.
approveCoupons writes the couponAllowances entry for the owner/spender pair.
transferCoupons moves coupon and underlying entries between two accounts.
vote reads and updates candidate start/period, approve, reject and per-account votes.
vote compares the current epoch with the candidate start/period window.
commit reads candidate vote tallies to evaluate quorum and approval.
commit requires epoch() > endsAfter before upgrading.
emergencyCommit reads candidate approve/reject totals for the super-majority check.
Regulator.step stores the captured price into _state13.price via setPrice.
initialize replaces provider.oracle with the new sushi oracle and keeps the legacy one.
couponRedemptionPenalty reads the current epoch to compute the coupon age.
couponPremium uses totalDebt as input to the curve calculation.
increaseSupply tops up the redeemable pool via mintToRedeemable.
increaseSupply/resetDebt reduce outstanding debt before distributing new supply.
mintToAccount increases global debt when not bootstrapping.
redeemToAccount decrements the total redeemable balance after paying coupons.
Coupon premium accounting depends on the mint/debt bookkeeping performed by mintToAccount.
purchaseCoupons calls couponPremium to size the deposit+premium total.
redeemCoupons pays the caller through redeemToAccount.
redeemCoupons calls couponRedemptionPenalty for the burn amount.
mintToAccount executes dollar().mint to create new DSD.
burnFromAccount pulls the caller's DSD with dollar().transferFrom.
burnFromAccount destroys the pulled DSD with dollar().burn.
burnFromAccount decrements global debt after the burn.
redeemToAccount mints fresh DSD to the redeemer.
redeemToAccount transfers the coupon DSD to the redeemer.
oracleCapture performs the external oracle().capture() call.
Regulator.step obtains the price from oracleCapture.
Regulator.step calls increaseSupply when price is above peg.
advance invokes Regulator.step to rebase supply.
advance invokes Market.step to expire and schedule coupons.
advance is wrapped by the incentivized modifier that pays the caller.
The incentivized modifier queries Chainlink aggregators for ETH and gas prices.
The modifier mints a caller-controlled, gas-derived incentive without any owner/role restriction.
The incentive conversion to DSD cost divides by the stored oracle price.
initialize mints the three initial 2000e18 DSD balances through mintToAccount.
initialize calls oracle.setup() and oracle.capture() to seed the pool price.
Expiring coupons in Market.step can trigger increaseSupply to true up redeemable.
increaseSupply mints pool, treasury, redeemable and DAO rewards.
withdraw performs dollar().transfer to msg.sender before decrementing the staged balance, violating checks-effects-interactions.
deposit pulls funds with dollar().transferFrom before crediting staged balance.
commit upgrades the proxy to the candidate after the quorum/approval checks.
emergencyCommit upgrades the proxy after the super-majority check.
upgradeTo delegatecalls initialize() on an attacker-nominated implementation, handing it the proxy storage and execution context.
upgradeTo writes the new implementation address into the implementation slot.
setImplementation writes the slot using inline assembly sstore.
setImplementation guards the implementation slot with isContract before writing.
Getters.implementation reads the implementation slot via assembly sload.
couponRedemptionPenalty computes penalties with unchecked uint256 subtraction/multiplication outside SafeMath.
The value parameter determines how much DSD is pulled and staged in deposit.
The amount parameter sizes the coupon purchase and the burned DSD.
couponEpoch selects which coupon bucket is redeemed and penalized.
amount selects how much coupon underlying is consumed in the redemption.
minOutput bounds the acceptable redemption payout.
candidate addresses the proposal being voted on.
vote selects which tally (approve/reject) is incremented or decremented.
newImplementation is stored and then delegatecalled by upgradeTo.
burnAmount reduces couponAmount and amount before the payout is computed.
newSupply is split between pool, treasury, redeemable and DAO payouts.
startGas differences determine the gas reimbursement minted by the modifier.
account is the mint recipient inside mintToAccount.
recipient receives the transferred coupon balance and underlying.

normalization_plan.reason: The external deposit amount is only meaningful inside deposit and is fully captured by its transferFrom/staged updates.
The purchase amount is bounded by the debt check inside purchaseCoupons and terminates in the coupon mint and burn.
The epoch selector only gates which coupon bucket redeemCoupons consumes.
The redeemed underlying amount is consumed entirely by the redemption bookkeeping and payout.
minOutput is a local slippage guard enforced by the Require.that check inside redeemCoupons.
The candidate address only indexes the candidate state mutated by vote.
The vote enum only selects the approve/reject tallies updated in vote.
The implementation address is the direct argument of the delegatecall performed by upgradeTo.
burnAmount is produced by the penalty function and only exists to subtract from the coupon/underlying amounts.
couponAmount is derived from the caller's coupon ratio and consumed by redeemToAccount inside redeemCoupons.
newSupply is the sole expansion quantity split and minted by increaseSupply.
startGas is a gas accounting variable used exclusively by the incentivized modifier to size the caller reward.
The account parameter is the recipient of the dollar().mint executed inside mintToAccount.
recipient is the destination of the coupon and underlying increments inside transferCoupons.
